description: bigville: THE PRINTED NEWSPAPER CARRIES ITS STORY. A physical newspaper copy (a Good `of_paper` the paper) in a resident's hands confers readership -- np_copy_confers_reading adds the `reads` edge the existing news/reach layer (np_reader_learns) already acts on. So the press-printed newspaper (414000), once bought/held, actually informs the reader; readership is possession, not just subscription. Ties the catalog-driven good into the living news layer.

rules.name: np_copy_confers_reading
rules.comment: A PHYSICAL newspaper carries its story: a resident who HOLDS a copy (a Good that is `of_paper` the paper, qty>=1) thereby READS the paper -- so a BOUGHT paper, not just a subscription, informs the reader. The existing np_reader_learns does the learning. Guarded against a duplicate reads edge (a subscriber who also holds a copy). Composes existing Terms; zero new Rust.
